Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer extracted and presented “Blackboys, East Sussex, England” from Britannica as Vivien Leigh’s place of death, which is incorrect. Vivien Leigh died in Belgravia, London. This introduced a wrong location into the workflow and could have led to an incorrect final answer. The agent failed to resolve the discrepancy by cross-verifying before reporting, and later loads of the same Britannica page showed “London, England,” indicating the earlier extraction was erroneous or outdated.
